General finite rank4 homology-cover construction under three explicit surface tests; all odd primes; infinite nonisomorphic finite minimal descendants for non-C polytope monodromy targets.

Every odd prime for all four2-primary source families at every beta>=5 and all independent sign choices: kernel F_ell^34, end kernels F_ell^9, medial kernel trivial, exact type{ell*p,q,ell*r}; infinitely many minimal descendants of nontrivial degrees ell^e,1<=e<=34.
